raw:
Handwritten math involves images, but the system appears to use LLMs for grading, with a RAG pipeline that links diagnosed difficulties to instructional materials. It is not clear that the RAG component is multimodal-only. The system does include a RAG pipeline and runs evaluation and a pilot deployment, so it qualifies as proposing a RAG system with experiments. The RAG component itself is not evaluated in the abstract, but the rules say not to exclude on that basis. The multimodal input (handwritten solutions) is a possible E9 concern, but the retrieval is over instructional text materials, so E9 is unlikely to apply.
